limitation_or_required_evidence: No successful frozen end-to-end configuration established by this audit

allowed_wording: A multicolor HSV fallback ranks contours by area times circularity

allowed_wording: The HSV branch applies an EMA with alpha 0.40
limitation_or_required_evidence: Reduced physical jitter or improved task performance not measured

limitation_or_required_evidence: No measured intrinsics or distortion calibration

allowed_wording: Association rejects scans received more than 1.2 seconds earlier

allowed_wording: When no LiDAR association exists the HSV branch estimates range from apparent diameter
limitation_or_required_evidence: Accuracy depends on size assumptions segmentation and intrinsics; no measurements

allowed_wording: Point x and y represent forward and lateral meters while z carries total range
